title: Shizue: free, open-source AI side panel for Chrome
description: Chat, summarize, and translate pages and YouTube captions in a Chrome side panel. Free and open source (MIT). Bring your own OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or OpenRouter key.
og_title: Shizue: your AI sidekick on every page
og_description: Free, open-source Chrome side panel for AI chat, page summaries, and bilingual page and YouTube caption translation. Bring your own API key.
h1: Your AI sidekick on every page
lede: Chat, summarize, and translate pages and YouTube captions in a Chrome side panel. Bring your own OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or OpenRouter key.
alt_youtube: Bilingual YouTube captions: Spanish with the English translation underneath
free_body: No paid plan, no account, no ads. You pay only your AI provider for what you use.
open_body: Every line of the extension is on GitHub under the MIT License.
private_body: No Shizue server and no tracking. Keys and history stay in your browser.
models_body: GPT, Claude, Gemini, and DeepSeek. One OpenRouter key covers them all.
alt_summary: Summarizing a page in the Shizue side panel
alt_translate: Bilingual page translation, original and translation side by side
alt_image_text: Extracting text from an image with the right-click menu
alt_models: Model selection, token usage, and local storage
faq_free_a: Yes, and it will stay free. You pay your AI provider (or OpenRouter) directly for the API calls you make, and the Token Usage chart shows how many tokens each model used.
faq_data_a: Only the content a feature needs, such as the page text for a summary, sent straight from your browser to the provider you chose. There is no Shizue server and no analytics. See the privacy policy.
faq_key_a: The simplest is one OpenRouter key: it unlocks every model in Shizue, including DeepSeek. If you already have an OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini key, that works too.
faq_more_q: Does it support local models or Firefox?
faq_more_a: Local models, yes: in Settings → Models, choose “Use a Local Model” to connect Ollama, LM Studio, or llama.cpp running on your computer, with no API key. Firefox, not yet. Follow the GitHub repository for updates.
end_body: Install in a few seconds. No sign-up.
